text: 金十数据9月27日讯，在三大运营商线下营业厅，不少消费者都碰到过“免费领手机”“办宽带送礼品”的宣传。看似是办套餐就能白拿手机，实际是‌签了贷款合同‌，每月话费里包含还款金额。长期以来，这类分期业务一直是消费者投诉的集中领域。近日，有消息称，三大运营商已经暂停此类业务，致电电信、联通运营商客服以及移动“和包信用购”客服，对方均表示，此类分期购机项目已经暂停。电信分析师付亮认为，此次三大运营商集中叫停金融分期购机业务，除了规范相关业务行为外，更深层的背景是通信市场步入存量时代，依靠补贴手机硬件抢夺用户的运营逻辑已难持续。
text_en: Jinshi Data, September 27 — At the offline business halls of the three major telecom operators, many consumers have encountered promotions such as "get a free phone" or "free gifts with broadband." It appears that you can get a phone for free by signing up for a plan, but in reality you are signing a loan contract, with the monthly phone bill including repayment amounts. For a long time, this type of installment business has been a concentrated area of consumer complaints. Recently, reports said the three major operators have suspended such business. Calls to customer service for China Telecom and China Unicom, as well as customer service for China Mobile's "Hebao Credit Purchase," all received responses that such installment phone purchase programs have been suspended. Telecom analyst Fu Liang believes that the concentrated halt of financial installment phone purchase business by the three major operators, besides regulating related business practices, has a deeper background: the communications market has entered an era of stock, and the operating logic of relying on subsidizing phone hardware to attract users is no longer sustainable.
